Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, July 28, 2015.

OATH OF OFFICE – SWEARING IN OF DEBORAH RICHIE-BRAY

the Parklands Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any

minutes_text:
ACTION MEMEO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  JULY 9, 2015

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  July 9, 2015
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, July 28, 2015.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

OATH OF OFFICE – SWEARING IN OF DEBORAH RICHIE-BRAY

ROLL CALL  Members present: Peterson, Kaviani, Richie-Bray &
  Rubincam

  Members absent: Wade

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

John Harbison, of 916 Via Panorama, expressed concern related to the following items:
   Chico Trail at Via Ramon has been blocked by unknown persons with cut logs
   Numerous encroachments still exist in the Parklands and have not been addressed
   The current Landscape Maintenance contract has been modified to remove a
  number of Parklands pathways from maintenance
   Acknowledged upcoming City Council meetings on 7/28 to discuss
  encroachments

CITIZEN APPLICATION

1.  PC-400-15; Application to remove 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent
  to 717 Via Del Monte and 1 Jacaranda located in the parkway adjacent to 718 Via
  Del Monte

  Applicant:  Dave Oberman
  812 Via Conejo
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, July 28, 2015.
  Director’s initials SR-L
 Action: Rubincam motioned Peterson seconded to approve PC-400-15; with
modification. The applicant is approved to trim both trees to reduce their height by
7 feet. If 7 feet is not sufficient, the applicant can re-submit to the Parklands
Committee for additional reduction in height. The vote was (4-0, Wade absent).

2.  PC-401-15; Application to remove 1 pine tree located in the parkway adjacent to
  1332 Via Gabriel

  Applicant:  Alan Haven
  2400 Via Sobrante
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Continued at the request of the applicant.

3.  PC-402-15; Application to remove 1 palm tree located in the parkway adjacent to
  3301 Via La Selva

  Applicant:  Jeff Aleixo
  3301 Via La Selva
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Kaviani motioned Rubincam seconded to approve PC-404-15; application to
remove 1 palm tree located in the parkway adjacent to 3301 Via La Selva according
to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’ including stump removal.
The vote was (4-0, Wade absent). The applicant is required to pay $500 to the ‘Tree
Bank’. The PC number was changed from 402 to 404 as 402 had been used
previously.

4.  PC-403-15; Application to remove 1 pine tree located in the parkway adjacent to
  1633/1637 Via Margarita

  Applicant:  Phyllis Spierer
  1637 Via Margarita
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Kaviani motioned Richie-Bray seconded to approve PC-403-15; application
to remove 1 pine tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1633/37 Via Margarita
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. The vote was
(4-0, Wade absent). Stump grinding of the stump is limited to the grinding to just
below grade to avoid harm to the adjacent tree. A $500 payment to the ‘Tree Bank’
is required.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, July 28, 2015.
  Director’s initials SR-L
 NEW BUSINESS

5.  Discussion for a conceptual landscape design for the triangle center medians at
  Palos Verdes Drive West and Palos Verdes Drive North intersection

The Committee recommended two options. Requests City Council to consider a
design competition with an established not to exceed budget or alternatively have
the Urban Forester prepare a conceptual design for further review.

OLD BUSINESS

6.  Changes to Parklands Application Process

Discussed process. Requested notice to adjacent property owners within 300 feet
and public notice boards be provided 20 days in advance of Parklands Committee
review.

7.  Discussion of possible landscape modifications to address the drought and
  mandatory water restrictions

The Committee reviewed possible locations to reduce or eliminate watering to
address the State Mandate. The Committee requested additional information
regarding square feet of grass lawn and related CCF’s required to water. The
Committee acknowledged the requirement to turn off irrigation of decorative turf in
center street medians. Areas with grass included for irrigation shut down or
reduction:

  1.  Plaza Asturias  center median R-O-W  turn off
  2.  Victoria Park  center median R-O-W  turn off
  3.  Paseo La Cresta medians  center medians R-O-W  turn off
  4.  Plaza Andres  center median R-O-W  turn off
  5.  Plaza Blanca  center median R-O-W  turn off
  6.  Gazebo medians  center medians R-O-W  turn off
  7.  George Allan  center median Parklands  water outfield 1 day
  8.  Wickton Plaza  parkway R-O-W  water 2 days only
  9.  P. V. Dr. W.  center medians R-O-W  water 2 days only
  Fountain medians  Re-evaluate need to
  turn off
  10. Gas Station L.B.  parkway R-O-W  reduce to 1 day

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, July 28, 2015.
  Director’s initials SR-L
 ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

8.  Update on current applications

Action: Reviewed and filed.

ADJOURNMENT

The Committee is adjourned to September 10, 2015.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, July 28, 2015.
  Director’s initials SR-L
